summary: Yemen's Houthi forces launched a massive missile and drone offensive against Saudi Arabia, striking Riyadh and Yanbu Aramco facilities, while claiming 732 Saudi air sorties. Simultaneously, an Israeli strike in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan killed two Palestinians, and the IDF confirmed the killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, a key hostage holder. Saudi Arabia responded by urging Pakistan and Turkey to activate a defense pact and initiate military action against the Houthis.
key_points: Houthi forces conducted large-scale ballistic, cruise missile and drone attacks on Riyadh and Yanbu Aramco facilities, causing large fires. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393229)
Israeli airstrike on a vehicle in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood killed two and injured several. (Source: @manniefabian/59191)
IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, involved in holding hostages and Lt. Hadar Goldin's body since 2014. (Source: @manniefabian/59192)
Saudi Arabia formally requested Pakistan and Turkey activate the Mecca defense pact and launch military operations against Houthis. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81100)
Intensive Israeli military helicopter flights observed over western Gaza Strip. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393234)
Suspected terrorist infiltration in Yitzhar settlement triggered sirens across West Bank settlements. (Source: @New_security8200/203851)
Iran conveyed conditions for ending war with US via Qatar; Trump extended Iran sanctions five years. (Source: @mamlekate/104555)
Russian ORSIS T-5000 sniper rifles entered Iran in high numbers for IRGC units. (Source: @kianmeli1/92269)

sections.executive_summary: Yemen's Houthi forces launched a massive missile and drone offensive against Saudi Arabia, striking Riyadh and Yanbu Aramco facilities, while claiming 732 Saudi air sorties. Simultaneously, an Israeli strike in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan killed two Palestinians, and the IDF confirmed the killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, a key hostage holder. Saudi Arabia responded by urging Pakistan and Turkey to activate a defense pact and initiate military action against the Houthis.

points: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei stated Iran has conveyed its conditions for stopping the war with the United States via Qatar and is awaiting President Trump's response, while Trump extended existing Iran sanctions for five years. (Source: @mamlekate/104555, @mamlekate/104547)

Russian-made ORSIS T-5000 sniper rifles have entered Iran in high numbers and been distributed to Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps units, as displayed during a Tehran military parade. (Source: @kianmeli1/92269)

Iran's National Security Commission approved a strategic clause requiring Iranian permission for any cable or data transmission equipment passing through the Strait of Hormuz, reinforcing maritime control. (Source: @SharghDaily/184595)
Turkish banking authorities revoked the operating license for Iran's Bank Melli central branch in Istanbul, coinciding with increased U.S. sanctions pressure on Tehran. (Source: @mamlekate/104547)
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu publicly mocked Iranian and Resistance Front leaders, chanting "Nasrallah, Sinwar, Haniyeh, Khamenei – killed" at a public event. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81090)
Israeli airstrike on a vehicle in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood killed two Palestinians and injured several others, according to Palestinian media reports. (Source: @manniefabian/59191)

IDF and Shin Bet confirmed the killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, who was involved in holding Israeli hostages including Sgt. Nimrod Cohen and the body of Lt. Hadar Goldin since 2014. (Source: @manniefabian/59192)

Gunfire hit an Israeli civilian vehicle near Al-Mughayyir village in the Benjamin Brigade area; no casualties reported, security forces launched scans and imposed blockades on the village. (Source: @New_security8200/203841)
Intensive Israeli military helicopter flights were observed over western Gaza Strip, indicating heightened aerial activity. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393234)

Yemen's Houthi forces launched a large-scale attack on Saudi Arabia using numerous ballistic and cruise missiles and drones, targeting sensitive sites in Riyadh and Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu, causing large fires. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7261, @rasedal3ado138e/393229)

Yemeni Armed Forces claimed two successful operations: first targeting Riyadh, second targeting Aramco in Yanbu; they also claimed 732 Saudi air strikes from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases using F-15 and Typhoon jets. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393229)

Saudi Arabia formally requested Pakistan and Turkey to activate the Mecca defense pact and initiate military operations against the Houthis following the attack on Riyadh's King Khalid Airport. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81100)
Two Aramco fuel tanks north of Riyadh were hit and caught fire; Riyadh air traffic was briefly disrupted before resuming. (Source: @shin_persian/10204, @shin_persian/10198)
Houthi official Mohammed al-Bukhaiti warned Turkey and Pakistan against intervening in support of Saudi Arabia, threatening "iron fist" strikes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7260)
Chinese embassy in Riyadh urged Chinese citizens and organizations to enhance safety measures and seek shelter upon local security alerts. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90999)
